transformation: These are synthetic relation-shaped records mapped field by field from two official OpenFEC Schedule A API results for one image. API decimal and integer JSON numbers become lossless strings; the API date becomes the relation's midnight timestamp; the API load_date maps to the PostgreSQL timestamp-without-time-zone lexical form; API recipient committee codes map to cmte_tp, org_tp, and cmte_dsgn; API-only nested master objects are omitted; dump-only tsvector fields are null. The separate Schedule A API contract preserves the exact response values. These fixtures do not claim to be extracted dump rows and cannot validate physical restore behavior.

scenarios: related amount must not be double counted
